notes.title: 1.04.00 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312837/22ef9c3df815d57ca7f06dbc014c30a3746e69ce.png[/img]

# New Feature
- Added in-game dialogues
    * About credit status
    * About progress status
- Added 3 new BGM tracks
    * Adjusted conditions for certain BGM to play

# Other Update
- Extended the time before automatic deletion of customer information
- Increased difficulty for triggering the charity campaign
- Automatic check for tutorial skip
- Replaced some character illustrations

# Tweaks
- Reduced load impact when starting the game
- Restricted pausing during the ending sequence
- Restricted pausing during loading screens
- Fixed an issue where some translations were missing when exiting the game
- Internal adjustments related to Steamworks
